requirement: The HIL replay manifest declares shadow-only scope, ROS clock replay, actuator-bridge disablement, and archive gates.
boundary: Template audit only; it does not prove a bag has been recorded or replayed.

requirement: The HIL manifest requires the same 13 preflight topics listed in the ROS2 topic contract.
boundary: Topic-name agreement is static; runtime topic discovery remains required in ROS2.

requirement: The multi-robot rosbag record command includes every required contract topic.
boundary: Command text coverage is not evidence that the topics were present in a recorded bag.

requirement: HIL replay command uses ROS clock playback.
evidence: rosbag command and manifest both contain --clock
boundary: Clock replay command presence does not prove node use_sim_time was enabled at runtime.

requirement: The manifest keeps the actuator bridge disabled through Stage C and lists physical command topics as forbidden before the gate.
boundary: This is an operator/process gate, not a physical interlock measurement.

requirement: The launch file wires selected-leader, safety-state, and results-CSV topics needed for HIL replay logs.
boundary: Launch wiring is static; ros2 launch execution remains a ROS2-environment gate.

requirement: The velocity safety controller publishes a JSON safety-state stream alongside bounded shadow commands.
boundary: Static source inspection does not prove message publication rate or ROS2 serialization.

requirement: The trial supervisor consumes safety-state JSON and carries the safety-stop reason into status summaries.
boundary: Static source inspection does not prove online safety-supervisor behaviour.

requirement: The preflight trial matrix covers TF dry-run, offline bag replay, HIL shadow replay, and closed-loop gate stages.
boundary: Planned trial coverage is not evidence that any trial has been executed.

requirement: Stage C HIL shadow replay includes 20 planned repeats across baseline, full, timeout-ablation, and full dropout-brake cases.
boundary: Repeat budget is a protocol plan, not collected HIL evidence.

requirement: Stage D closed-loop gate remains low speed and follows HIL shadow evidence.
boundary: The row plan does not prove operator supervision or robot motion.

requirement: Metric schema includes timing, frame-drop, watchdog, command-age, clock-drift, and CPU/GPU fields required before real-world claims.
boundary: Metric schema presence does not supply measured latency values.

requirement: Results CSV template includes completion, contact, stop, near-miss, lost, distance, and TTC fields.
boundary: Template fields do not prove filled per-trial results.

requirement: Run-manifest template captures rosbag path, clock-sync method, and shadow-command-first safety gate.
boundary: A blank manifest template must be filled during a real HIL or robot run.

requirement: HIL acceptance criteria cover topic completeness, clock sync, shadow command, safety-state logs, command safety, timing, contact boundary, and archival.
boundary: Acceptance criteria are predeclared; they do not certify that evidence exists yet.

requirement: HIL manifest lists the minimum raw evidence artifacts required for later repository deposit.
boundary: Archive checklist is not a DOI-backed repository deposit.

requirement: Rosbag command notes preserve a shadow-command-first boundary before physical base control.
boundary: Operator compliance still has to be observed during real HIL setup.
